description.intro: The Nike Brasil Dri-FIT Academy Pro Kids Trousers is designed to train young footballers with comfort and style inspired by the Brazilian team. Their trullo color design reflects the modern identity of the Canarinha.
key_benefits: Nike Dri-FIT technology: Evacuate sweat to keep skin dry and comfortable during exercise.
Design Academy Pro: Inspired by the training garments used in academies and professional teams.
Low with zipper: They facilitate to put on and remove the pants even with the shoes on.
Lightweight and flexible fabric: Promotes freedom of movement during training.
